couplets.en: There is no you, no grief, no wine.
There is no answer to such loneliness.

lines: Dil se behtar koi kitaab nahin
couplets.en: Read it now and then, for there is no better book than the heart.

lines: Jaane kis-kis ki maut aayi hai
couplets.en: Who knows whose hour has come?

lines: Jaane kis-kis ki maut aayi hai
Aaj rukh pe koi naqaab nahin
couplets.en: Who knows whose hour has come, now that your face is unveiled?

lines: Aaj rukh pe koi naqaab nahin
Aisi tanhaai ka jawaab nahin, tum nahin, gham nahin, sharaab nahin
couplets.en: Your face is unveiled today, and there is no answer to this solitude without you, without grief, without wine.
